create_rmsnorm_module: create a Haiku RMSNorm module to normalize inputs by root-mean-square over specified axes
build_rmsnorm_with_scale: build an RMSNorm layer with a trainable scale parameter applied after normalization
test_rmsnorm_normalization: test the RMSNorm module to verify inputs are normalized by RMS without mean recentering
refactor_rmsnorm_axis: refactor the RMSNorm axis parameter to support int, slice, or iterable of ints
review_rmsnorm_call: review the RMSNorm __call__ method to understand the normalization and scaling computation
